scope: P0.6 original handlers with PostgreSQL atomic triggers

checks.name: production SQL adapter uses restricted LOGIN
concurrent original startExam creates one attempt
concurrent save patches survive and resume unchanged
done rejects save and has one result event
save versus submit preserves accepted answers and final state
expired and revoked subscription deny original handlers
start mirror failure rolls back whole route transaction
save mirror failure preserves answers and both copies
submit event mirror failure rolls back attempt grade and event
retry after rollback commits once and done result stays immutable
GET settlement mirror failure rolls back grade and event
GET settles saved answers with one immutable result event
authorization failures do not alter source or shadow; answer key hidden
no duplicate active attempts or result events after all handler cases

limitations: Auth identity and rate-limit transport are fixtures; no live Supabase Auth/Storage
Known pg concurrent client.query deprecation remains visible in original GET; no test-only serialization workaround
No migration, backfill, cutover, HTTP load, or SSI closure
